info.name: MTG Marketplace API
info.description:
Buy, sell and collect Magic: The Gathering cards. Endpoints live under /v1; authenticate with a Supabase access token as a bearer token.

Generated by src/scripts/export_api.py.

request.description: Signs in with email and password and stores the access token in {{token}}. Set supabaseAnonKey, email and password in the collection variables first (use a test account; tokens expire after an hour).
Card names for a search box: substring and typo-tolerant, one per card.

query.description: Part of the type line, e.g. Creature
Color identity includes all of these, e.g. UR

request.description: Printings matching every given filter, sorted by name.
Every printing of one card (all sets and languages), newest first.
One printing, with its marketplace prices and Scryfall's reference prices.
Recent sales on the marketplace, newest first.

NM market price changes over the last days. Each point holds until the
next; the first is the price when the period began.
A starting price for a listing of this card.

query.description: Match the lines and report, without adding anything

request.description:
Add cards from a pasted decklist or CSV export. Lines that can't be
matched are listed in `unmatched`; the rest are added (unless dry_run).
A seller's storefront. The seller also sees their sold and removed listings.
Listings of one printing for sale, cheapest first.
How many are for sale and the lowest price, per condition and finish.
Orders the caller bought, or (role=seller) paid orders they sold.
Seller: the order is on its way. Pays the seller out, unless they were paid when the buyer paid.
Buyer: the cards arrived. Both sides can then rate each other.
Seller: cancel an unshipped order and refund the buyer in full.
A seller's flat shipping options, cheapest first.
Whether the caller has set up payouts and their listings can be bought.
Stripe's payout setup forms. Redirect to the url straight away: it expires within minutes.
The seller's Stripe dashboard, for payouts and bank details.
The cart grouped by seller, with any lines that can't be bought as they are.
Add a listing to the cart, or set how many copies of it.

Hold the cart's copies and open a Stripe payment page (url) for them,
one order per seller. The hold ends at expires_at if unpaid.
Poll this after Stripe sends the buyer back: status becomes paid once Stripe confirms.
Give up before paying; the copies go back on sale straight away.
The caller's scans, newest first.

Start scanning a card. With photo, returns a link to upload it to;
with the text read from it, also returns the matching cards.
Match the text read from the card against the catalog.
Add the scanned card to a collection.
The caller's wants lists, newest first.
Each item with the copies the caller owns and what's for sale.
Add the cards in a decklist.
Listings at or under the target price (max_price_cents) of an item.
The cheapest way found to buy the list, cards plus shipping, optionally added to the cart.
